column2:
[title27][sentence]
This plant looks suspiciously like the Terran plant
known as "chloro-decapatus", a rare
hostile carnivore with roots that go all the way back
to the infamous Venus Man Trap.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這株植物看起來很像地球上
俗稱「斷頭葉綠草」的植物，
是一種源自惡名昭彰
「食人捕蠅草」的稀有兇猛肉食植物。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
There is an odd looking plant here.  To the east
you see something floating above the ocean floor,
and to the south you can see your ship.  It's
seen better days.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這裡有株怪模怪樣的植物。
東邊有個東西懸浮在海底上方，
南邊則能看到你的太空船——
風光不再了。

column2:
[title32]PLANT FOOD
Well, that was a quick adventure.  Too bad
it had to end with you turning into plant
food.
column3:
[title32]花肥
好啦，這趟冒險還真夠短的。
可惜最後你落得變成
花肥的下場。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You are on a street corner at the base of a large
dome.  The dome is obviously 'Polly's Pleasure
Dome'.  There is also a seafood restaurant here,
and you also notice the end of the fishing line
you threw from above the city.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你站在一座大圓頂底下的街角，
這圓頂顯然就是『波莉歡樂
圓頂』。這裡還有間海鮮餐廳，
你也注意到先前從城市上方
丟下的釣魚線末端垂在這裡。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You are on a street corner at the base of a large
dome.  The dome is obviously 'Polly's Pleasure
Dome'.  There is also a seafood restaurant here,
as well as a boat which has been moored with
fishing line.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你站在一座大圓頂底下的街角，
這圓頂顯然就是『波莉歡樂
圓頂』。這裡還有間海鮮餐廳，
以及一艘用釣魚線繫住的船。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You are on a street corner at the base of a large
dome.  The dome is obviously 'Polly's Pleasure
Dome'.  There is also a seafood restaurant here.
You are just a few yards from the tall vertical
perimeter wall of the city.  Above that you can
see clear blue sky.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你站在一座大圓頂底下的街角，
這圓頂顯然就是『波莉歡樂
圓頂』。這裡還有間海鮮餐廳。
你距離城市那道高聳筆直的
外牆只有幾碼遠，牆的上方
可以看見一片晴朗的藍天。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis is the MLV you arrived in.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這是你搭來的那輛磁浮車。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
The sidewalk is interrupted only by the
lovely legs of a large statue.  The sidewalk
continues south another few yards
then ends at the vertical perimeter wall
of the city.  To the east the sidewalk
continues another few blocks and then
turns north.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
人行道只被一座大型雕像
那雙美腿打斷。人行道往南
再延伸幾碼後，就會抵達
城市的垂直外牆而中斷。
往東的話，人行道還會
繼續延伸幾個街區，
然後轉向北方。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThis is a big city.  You decide to stay close\nto the car so that you won't get lost.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這是一座大城市。你決定\n待在車子附近，免得迷路。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Wow!  You gather this must have been
quite a place--when there were people here
that is.  The lights are still working, but
there doesn't appear to be anyone inside.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
哇！你猜這裡以前一定很
熱鬧——至少在還有人住的
時候是這樣。燈還亮著，
但裡面似乎沒半個人。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
There isn't anyone in there.  You note that the
prices are listed in a denomination you have
never heard of before.  They obviously don't
take galactars here.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
裡面沒有半個人。你注意到
標價用的是你從沒聽過的
貨幣單位。這裡顯然不收
銀河幣。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It appears to be locked.  The lock mechanism
also looks corrosion welded.  Even if you
had a key it's unlikely you would be able
to get this thing open.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
看起來鎖住了。鎖的機構
似乎也因鏽蝕而卡死。
就算你有鑰匙，恐怕
也打不開這東西。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Sorry, wrong key.  Even if it were the
correct key, the lock is so badly corroded
that you doubt it would operate.  This
lock is going to stay locked.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
抱歉，鑰匙不對。就算是
對的鑰匙，這鎖也鏽蝕得
太嚴重，恐怕根本轉不動。
這把鎖注定就是打不開了。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Blowing the door off its hinges
would probably also destroy anything
interesting inside.  Why don't you just
give up on this place and worry about
getting that vase!
column3:
[title29][sentence]
把門炸離鉸鏈，大概也會
順便炸爛裡面任何值得看的
東西。你何不乾脆放棄這裡，
專心去煩惱那個花瓶就好！

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The scales on the building and the boat
suspended overhead lead you to believe
that this is a seafood restaurant.  You are
wary of walking under that boat though--the
cables don't look too strong.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
建築物上的魚鱗裝飾，加上
懸在頭頂上方的那艘船，讓你
猜這裡是間海鮮餐廳。不過你
不太敢走到船底下——那些
纜繩看起來不太牢靠。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You see a small restaurant with
a few tables and a counter.  There
appears to be a cash register on 
the counter but you can't make
out any more details from here.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你看到一間小餐廳，裡面
有幾張桌子和一個櫃台。
櫃台上似乎有台收銀機，
但從這裡看不出更多細節。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This appears to be a functional boat
that someone hung over the seafood
restaurant to give it 'atmosphere'.
The cables holding it there are attached
to something on the upper level of the
city.  It must have been quite a job hanging
it here.  Lowering it would probably be
somewhat simpler, but you'd have to find
the upper ends of the cables first.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這艘船似乎還能用，是有人
掛在這間海鮮餐廳上方，用來
營造『氣氛』的。吊著它的
纜繩，另一端接在城市上層的
某個東西上。當初把它吊上來
想必費了一番工夫。要把它
放下來大概簡單得多，但你得
先找到那些纜繩的上端才行。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou have successfully lowered the boat onto the street.\nNow what?
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你成功把船放到了街上。\n接下來呢？

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You have tied the fishing line to the boat.
It is now tethered to the maintenance platform
on the upper rim of the city.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你把釣魚線綁到了船上。
現在船繫在城市上緣的
維修平台上了。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The fishing line you threw from
the maintenance platform is hanging
down in front of the restaurant.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你從維修平台丟下的釣魚線，\n正垂掛在餐廳前方。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Wow!  You would give your left
pinkie to meet the woman who
modeled for this statue!
column3:
[title27][sentence]
哇！你願意用左手小指
換一次機會，見見這座
雕像的模特兒本人！

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The scales on the building and the boat
now lowered to the street lead you to believe
that this is a seafood restaurant.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
建築物上的魚鱗裝飾，加上
那艘已經放到街上的船，
讓你猜這裡是間海鮮餐廳。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou already tied the line to the boat.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你已經把釣魚線綁在船上了。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You have nothing to tie the line to right
now, so there is no point in picking up
the loose end.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你現在沒有東西可以綁
釣魚線，撿起鬆脫的那端
也沒有意義。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
There's no point in tying the line to the
boat right now, since the line is not secured
to anything.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
現在把線綁到船上沒有
意義，因為線根本沒固定
在任何東西上。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nYou cannot reach the boat to tie the line to\nit.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n你搆不到船，沒辦法把線綁上去。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nThe fishing line is firmly tied to the boat.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n釣魚線已牢牢綁在船上了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
These cannon balls add to the distinctly
military feeling of this corridor.  They look
ceremonial, but you still would not want to meet
one traveling a thousand feet per second.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這些砲彈為走廊增添了
濃濃的軍事氣息。看起來
像是儀式用的，但你還是
不會想在時速千呎的情況下
和其中一顆迎面相遇。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
Looking for a workout? The thought of
carrying around several heavy metallic
weights violates your religious hatred for
exercise.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
想找點運動做嗎？一想到
要扛著好幾個沉重的金屬
砝碼到處走，就違背了你
對運動近乎信仰般的厭惡。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nYou shudder at the thought of drinking\nsomething non-alcoholic.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n一想到要喝不含酒精的東西，\n你就不寒而慄。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Obviously this corridor serves some
purpose other than transportation.
The backboard looks well used.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這條走廊顯然不只是用來
通行的。那塊籃板看起來
用得很勤。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
It appears that this light was installed
to aid in refereeing games.  It lights
up whenever someone scores.  If you
had one of these, it would be continuously
dark.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
看來這盞燈是為了輔助
裁判而裝的，只要有人
得分就會亮起。如果換成
是你，這盞燈大概永遠
都是暗的。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
This must be the way to open the large door.
You probably need a highly classified
mega-secret security badge to insert into
the slot.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這應該就是打開那扇大門
的方法。你大概需要一張
高度機密的超級秘密保全
識別證，插進這個插槽裡。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe corridor continues east.  You see\na few more doors down that way.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n走廊往東繼續延伸。你看到\n那個方向還有幾扇門。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThe corridor continues up a northwest slope\nfor ten yards or so, then heads north.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
走廊沿著西北向的斜坡
往上延伸約十碼，然後
轉往北方。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Apparently, this gadget monitors ambient
light, or air density, or something like that.
To your untrained eye it appears that
whatever is being monitored is in good shape.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這個裝置似乎是在監測
環境光線，或空氣密度之類
的東西。以你外行的眼光
來看，被監測的東西狀況
似乎不錯。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
You are at the western end of an east-west
corridor.  A pile of cannon balls complements
a large door to the north.  A drinking fountain
and smaller door are also visible.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你位在一條東西向走廊的
西端。一堆砲彈點綴著北邊
的一扇大門。這裡還看得到
一座飲水機和一扇較小的門。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The large door appears to be made of
a material which is stronger than you are.
Next to the door is a small card slot.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這扇大門看起來是用比你
還硬的材質做的。門旁邊
有個小小的卡片插槽。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis doorway appears to lead to an\narmory of sorts.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這道門看起來通往某種\n軍械庫。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThe small door is open.\nYou see a familiar device inside.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n那扇小門開著。你看到\n裡面有個眼熟的裝置。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The simulated coach lamp looks
like something your decorator would
install.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這盞仿馬車燈的樣式，
看起來像是你的室內設計師
會裝的那種。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
There are several supports here.  You
briefly wonder why they are needed
in a cavity carved from solid rock.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這裡有幾根支柱。你一時
納悶，在這種從實心岩石
鑿出來的洞穴裡，到底
為什麼需要這些支柱。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The [noun1] doesn't fit.  You must
need something else.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
[noun1]不合，你可能
需要別的東西。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nYou don't have a target module.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你身上沒有瞄準模組。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou don't have a shield modulator.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你身上沒有護盾調變器。

column2: [title32][sentence]\nIt would be unwise to remove the\nlife support module.
column3: [title32][sentence]\n拆掉維生模組可不是\n什麼明智之舉。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The scanner is built into the hallway
in such a way that you cannot travel
farther without passing through it.  It
looks rather menacing from here.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這台掃描器直接嵌在走廊
裡，你不穿過它就沒辦法
繼續往前走。從這裡看，
它顯得頗有威脅感。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou conclude from your past experiences\nthat this is some kind of gender scanner.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n憑過去的經驗，你判斷\n這是某種性別掃描器。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You can't see anything from here,
but it sounds like a hopin place.
You were beginning to wonder what
people did around here for
recreation.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
從這裡什麼都看不到，
但聽起來像是個熱鬧的
地方。你正開始納悶，
這裡的人平常都做什麼
消遣。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Ladies' night!  Great!  Then again, that's
not much of a surprise on a planet with
no men on it.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
仕女之夜！讚喔！不過話說
回來，在一個沒有男人的
星球上，這也沒什麼好意外的。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe corridor south leads around a corner\nand out of sight.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n南邊的走廊轉過一個彎角，\n消失在視線之外。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis corridor leads back toward the detention area.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這條走廊通往拘留區的方向。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
There is an odd looking scanner in the middle
of the corridor.  You also notice an electric
sign over a doorway.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
走廊中間有台造型古怪的
掃描器。你還注意到一扇門
上方掛著一塊電子招牌。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The cash register looks old and decrepit.  This must
not have been a very profitable restaurant.  You
cant help but think that a few more tables would
have helped.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這台收銀機看起來又老又
破舊。這間餐廳想必生意
不怎麼好。你忍不住想，
多擺幾張桌子搞不好會有
幫助。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe old decrepit cash register is open.\nAlas, however, it is empty.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這台又老又破的收銀機開著，\n可惜裡面空空如也。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The old decrepit cash register is open.
There is no cash inside, but you do spot
a small key.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這台又老又破的收銀機開著。
裡面沒有現金，但你發現
一把小鑰匙。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe key appears to be the type normally\nused for padlocks.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這把鑰匙看起來是一般\n掛鎖在用的那種。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
No self-respecting seafood restaurant
would be without the obligatory
fishing-rod-glued-to-the-wall.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
稍微有點格調的海鮮餐廳，
牆上都少不了這種黏死的
釣竿裝飾。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You grab the fishing rod from the wall,
bend it around itself a few times, and
carefully stuff it in your pocket.  You
sincerely hope that the rod doesn't choose
to expand unexpectedly (like in grade
school) and destroy your pants.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你從牆上扯下釣竿，把它
繞著自己彎了好幾圈，
小心翼翼塞進口袋裡。你
由衷希望這根釣竿別突然
彈開（就像小學時那樣），
把你的褲子毀了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
That makes a wonderful wall ornament.
You momentarily imagine a ship on the
ocean somewhere, carrying a frustrated
captain who is unable to steer it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這東西當壁飾真不錯。你
一時想像某片海洋上，有艘
船正載著一位滿肚子火、
卻沒辦法操舵的船長。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Don't bother.  The automatic system in the
car seem to work just fine.  Besides, you
don't have the tools to attach it.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
別費心了。車上的自動
系統運作得好好的。再說，
你也沒有工具可以把它裝上去。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
The sky and horizon are painted on pieces
of paper, over which the portholes have been
nailed.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
天空和地平線只是畫在
紙上的，紙的上面還釘著
一個個舷窗。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It's clear that the owner of this restaurant
didn't spend a great deal of money on tables.
He probably grabbed these old coil spools
from a nearby junkyard.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
很明顯，這間餐廳的老闆
沒在桌子上花什麼錢。他
大概是從附近的廢料場
撿了這些舊纜線捲軸來充數。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe old dried-out starfish have been\nattached to the wall with a staple gun.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這些乾癟的老海星，是用\n釘槍釘在牆上的。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou have had enough of carrying fish\naround for one day.  Leave them alone.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n今天扛魚扛得夠多了，\n別再管它們了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Nothing has changed since you came inside.
You car hasn't been stolen--at least not since
you stole it earlier today.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
自從你進來之後，一切都
沒變。你的車沒被偷——
至少從你今天稍早把它
偷來以後就沒再被偷過。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This appears to be your standard tacky
seafood restaurant.  All manner of artifacts
have been glued/nailed/stapled to the walls.
The tables are cheap cable spools, the
chairs sicken you with their hideous color,
and the marlin trophy on the back wall smells.
The only things missing are lobster pot buoys
and a fish net hanging from the ceiling.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這看起來就是標準的俗氣
海鮮餐廳。各式各樣的
擺飾用膠水黏、釘子釘、
釘書針釘滿了整面牆。
桌子是廉價的纜線捲軸，
椅子的顏色醜得讓你反胃，
後牆上那條馬林魚標本還發出臭味。
少的大概只剩龍蝦籠浮球，
和掛在天花板上的一張魚網。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou figure that this might come in handy\nand quietly slip it into your pocket.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你覺得這東西可能派得上\n用場，便悄悄把它塞進口袋。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This looks like a picture of a beach
stolen from a travel agency.  It
is faded and cracked.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這看起來像是從旅行社
偷來的海灘照片，已經
褪色又龜裂了。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nYou don't need the stupid poster.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n你才不需要這張蠢海報。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The marlin trophy on the back wall
is smelling the room up.  The strange
sea monster head near the cash register
looks familiar, though.  Hey!  He looks
a lot like that ugly thing that you saw
through the underwater viewport.  The
one in the underwater viewport was a
LOT bigger.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
後牆上的馬林魚標本正把
整個房間薰得臭氣沖天。
不過收銀機旁邊那顆怪異
的海怪頭倒是有點眼熟。
嘿！牠長得很像你透過水下
觀景窗看到的那隻醜東西。
只不過觀景窗裡那隻，
體型大上「非常」多。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The marlin trophy on the back wall
is smelling the room up.  The strange
sea monster head near the cash register
looks rather odd.  You wonder if
such a beast could possibly exist.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
後牆上的馬林魚標本正把
整個房間薰得臭氣沖天。
收銀機旁邊那顆怪異的
海怪頭看起來相當離奇。
你納悶這種怪獸是否
真的存在過。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis type of cheap plastic-molded\nchair always makes your back hurt.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這種廉價塑膠模製椅，\n坐起來永遠讓你腰痠背痛。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Evidently there was so little business
here that the owner had to close off
the rest of the dining room.  At least
you probably got personal service.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
看來這裡生意太差了，
老闆只好把用餐區其他
部分封起來。至少你大概
能享受到專屬服務吧。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It's not even real hemp.  If you leaned on
it, it would probably disintegrate.  You
have no use for such a lousy piece of rope.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這甚至不是真正的麻繩。
只要靠上去，大概就會
散開。這種爛繩子你
派不上用場。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The tacky lamps cast a dim glow over
each table.  You are surprised that the
obviously cheap restaurant owner was
willing to pay for the electricity to light
this place.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些俗氣的燈，替每張桌子
投下昏暗的光。你很意外，
這麼小氣的餐廳老闆居然
願意花電費點亮這個地方。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThe cash register is the only thing on\nthe counter that catches your eye.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n櫃台上唯一吸引你目光的，\n就是那台收銀機。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou hunt around for a moment, eventually\nfinding the 'no sale' key . . . .
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你翻找了一會兒，總算\n找到那個『無銷售』鍵……

column2:
[title30][sentence]
It looks like they might have sold
fresh fish here too.  There are three
ice chests built in to the counter.
They probably haven't been
emptied in a LONG time.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
看樣子這裡以前也賣新鮮
魚貨。櫃台裡嵌著三個
冰櫃，大概已經「很久」
沒清空過了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Just before your hand reaches the handle
on the nearest ice chest cover, you pause
and think for a moment.  How long has it
been since these bins have been cleaned?
Could there be hundred-year old dead fish
inside of these things?  Since you forgot to
bring your anti-chemical warfare gear, you
decide not to open the chests.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
就在你的手快摸到最近那個
冰櫃蓋把手時，你停下來
想了想。這些櫃子上次清理
是多久以前的事了？裡面
會不會躺著上百年的死魚？
既然忘了帶防化裝備，你
決定還是別開這些冰櫃了。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The register is already open.  If you
keep yanking on it, the drawer will
probably come crashing out onto the
floor.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
收銀機已經開著了。你要是
再一直拉它，抽屜大概會
直接摔到地上。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You are seated in a small, well-equipped,
private one-man spacecraft.  It appears
to be a sports model.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你坐在一艘小型、配備
齊全的單人私人太空船裡，
看起來像是跑車型號。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThrough the glass you can see the trees\nin the distance.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n透過玻璃，你能看到\n遠方的樹木。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Through the glass you can see the trees
in the distance, although they appear
strangely tinted when seen through
the anti-grav beam.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
透過玻璃，你能看到遠方
的樹木，不過透過反重力
光束看過去，樹木的顏色
顯得有點古怪。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
There is a small fracture in the
ship's canopy.  It may still be air worthy,
but you would feel nervous taking the
ship into hard vacuum in this condition.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
船艙罩上有道小裂縫。
或許還能維持氣密，但
以這種狀態把船開進真空，
你恐怕會捏一把冷汗。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
You have done an excellent job repairing
the crack in the canopy.  This ship should
now be airtight.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你把艙罩上的裂縫修得
很漂亮。這艘船現在應該
已經氣密了。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
After spending a moment examining the
controls you are confident that you could
fly this ship.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n稍微研究了一下操控裝置後，\n你有信心能駕駛這艘船。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Glancing at the status panel you
learn that you have a full tank of
fuel, that the warp coils are in
good shape, and that you are
sitting in a one-gravity field.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
瞄了一眼狀態面板，你
發現燃料是滿的，曲速
線圈狀況良好，而且你
現在位於一個標準重力場。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Glancing at the status panel you
learn that you have a full tank of
fuel, that the warp coils are in
good shape, and that you are
sitting in an artificially produced
microgravity field.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
瞄了一眼狀態面板，你
發現燃料是滿的，曲速
線圈狀況良好，而且你
現在位於一個人工微重力場中。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nWhoever once owned this ship was prepared\nfor long journeys.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這艘船以前的主人，顯然\n是為長途旅行做足了準備。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou don't need to use it just yet.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你現在還用不著這個。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
The instrumentation appears
to be in working order.
You are confident that you could
pilot this craft.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n儀器看起來運作正常。\n你有信心能駕駛這艘船。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The seat is quite comfortable.   You have
been wanting one of these sports models
for some time, but never seem to have
the money.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這座椅相當舒適。你早就
想要一台這種跑車型號，
但一直都湊不出錢來。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You give the throttle a few pulls,
then realize that this ship was designed
for low-gravity or null-gravity launches.
You are sitting in full gravity, so this ship
isn't going anywhere.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你拉了幾下節流閥，才
發現這艘船是設計來在
低重力或零重力環境下
起飛的。你現在處於標準
重力，這艘船哪裡都去不了。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You reach for the lever . . . no! You just
can't bring yourself to leave this planet
without that vase.  You have never
failed to complete a job, and you aren't
going to start now.  Besides, you need that
money for a down payment on a new ship.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你伸手去拉操縱桿……不行！
你就是沒辦法丟下那個
花瓶離開這顆星球。你這輩子
沒失手過一次，現在也不會
破例。再說，你還等著那筆
錢去付新船的頭期款呢。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nYou give the throttle a pull and feel the engines\nfire up . . . .
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你拉動節流閥，感覺到\n引擎點火啟動……

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Remembering that poor splattered mammal outside
you decide to turn off the anti-grav field before
opening the canopy.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
想起外頭那隻可憐、被拍成
肉餅的哺乳動物，你決定
先關掉反重力場，再打開艙罩。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You squirt a large blob of polycement into
the deepest section of the crack.  The cement
hardens almost instantly.  You are confident
that your handiwork will allow you to fly
through space without losing cabin pressure.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你把一大坨強力膠擠進
裂縫最深的地方。膠幾乎
瞬間就硬化了。你有信心，
憑這手工，飛出太空也
不會漏氣減壓。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Since this teleporter is built into the wall,
there is nothing much to see through the
viewport.  These machines were obviously
designed for indoor and outdoor use--too bad
only the outdoor units offer a view.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
由於這台傳送器是嵌在
牆裡的，透過觀景窗其實
看不到什麼。這種機器顯然
是設計給室內外通用的——
可惜只有室外機型才有
風景可看。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The keypad has twelve keys on it.
The numerals zero through nine are
present, as well as 'smile' and 'frown'
keys.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這個鍵盤上有十二個按鍵，
除了0到9的數字鍵之外，
還有『笑臉』和『哭臉』鍵。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This entry device is about
as complicated as a pocket
calculator.  Take your time;
you'll get it eventually.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這個輸入裝置的複雜程度，
大概跟一台口袋型計算機
差不多。慢慢來，你遲早
會搞懂的。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nIt's a key.  Hint: it's about the same\nsize as the tip of a human finger.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這是一把鑰匙。提示：\n大小跟人類指尖差不多。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou are standing in an\nalien teleportation device.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你站在一台外星傳送\n裝置裡。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nWires, ducts, and girders cover the ceiling.\nApparently, the builders left it unfinished.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
天花板上布滿電線、
管道和大樑，顯然當初
建造者沒有完工。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The monitor provides useful information
about the local airspace.  You are
surprised that it is still operating.
Wait!  If these readings are correct, then that
large ship that shot you down is still
up there.  You're going to have to
get past that ship to get off this planet.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這台監視器提供關於當地
空域的有用資訊。你很意外
它居然還在運作。等等！
如果這些讀數沒錯，那艘
擊落你的大型戰艦還在
天上。你得想辦法繞過
那艘船，才能離開這顆星球。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis looks like every other teleporter\nyou have seen on this planet.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
這看起來就跟你在這顆
星球上見過的其他傳送器
一樣。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You recognize the equipment around
here as being essential to a small
airfield.  The radar screen and the
anti-grav control panels are
dead giveaways.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你認出這裡的設備，是
小型機場的必備裝置。
雷達螢幕和反重力控制
面板就是最明顯的線索。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The public address speaker remains
quiet.  You are thankful for this because
judging from it's size, it would make
a great deal of noise.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
廣播喇叭一直安靜無聲。
你為此感到慶幸，因為
從它的尺寸判斷，一旦
響起來肯定吵得要命。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
They must have used this to administer
vision tests to spacecraft pilots.  You
give the chart a quick glance and are
pleased to see that you still have 20-20
vision.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這東西想必是用來替太空船
飛行員做視力測驗的。你
瞄了一眼視力表，很高興
發現自己視力依然是滿分。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The only items of interest on the wall
are an eye chart, a control panel, and
a large radar monitor.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
牆上唯一值得留意的東西，
是一張視力表、一個控制
面板，和一台大型雷達螢幕。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe door is currently closed.\n
column3: [title18][sentence]\n這扇門目前是關著的。\n

column2:
[title33][sentence]

column3:

這座發射台看起來狀況

column2:

[title26][sentence]

發射台上靠近船的地方，

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This is probably one of those advanced
defense shield modulators.  You had one
just like it in the Slipper Pig.  It saved your
skin in that last space battle too.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這大概是那種先進的防禦
用護盾調變器。你在油豬號
上就有一個一模一樣的，
上次那場太空戰也是靠它
保住一命。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Thinking that it might come in handy,
you slip the shield modulator into your
pocket.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你覺得這東西可能派得上
用場，便把護盾調變器
塞進口袋裡。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
It looks like the remote control for your
audio tape player, except that it only has
one button.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這看起來像是你錄音機的
遙控器，只不過上面只有
一個按鈕。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
This ship is in sad shape.  A tree grew
through it at some point in its history,
destroying most of the engine components.
This ship is not going anywhere.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
這艘船的狀況很慘。歷史上
曾有棵樹長穿過它，把
大部分引擎零件都毀了。
這艘船哪裡都去不了了。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
This ship is in sad shape.  A tree grew
through it at some point in its history,
destroying most of the engine components.
This ship is not going anywhere.  There is
a familiar-looking device dangling from
the remains of the cockpit.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這艘船的狀況很慘。歷史上
曾有棵樹長穿過它，把
大部分引擎零件都毀了。
這艘船哪裡都去不了了。
駕駛艙殘骸上，垂掛著
一個看起來眼熟的裝置。

column2:
[title16][sentence]
The bushes are thick and impassable.  They seem
to be the predominant form of vegetation on this
part of the planet.
column3:
[title16][sentence]
這些灌木叢又厚又密，
根本過不去。看來這是
這一帶最主要的植被類型。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThere is another launch pad over\nthere, with a ship sitting on it.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n那邊還有一座發射台，\n上面停著一艘船。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe sky is blue and cloudless.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n天空湛藍無雲。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis ship is not worth stealing.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這艘船不值得偷。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou pick up the odd-looking remote\ncontrol and put it in your pocket.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你撿起那個造型古怪的\n遙控器，放進口袋裡。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
The trees here closely resemble the trees you
saw on the island near your crash site.  Perhaps
you aren't too far from there.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
這裡的樹跟你在墜機地點
附近那座島上看到的樹
非常相似。或許你離那裡
不算太遠。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nTo the west you see the building\nthat contains the control room.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n西邊可以看到那棟\n有控制室的建築。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
The launch pad here is in much better
shape than the one to the west.  No trees have
grown through it, the bushes seem to have kept
clear, and the ship sitting on it looks as if it's in
reasonably good condition.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這裡的發射台狀況比西邊
那座好多了。沒有樹長穿
過它，灌木叢似乎也保持
距離，停在上面的船看起來
狀態相當不錯。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nTo the west you see the poor ship with\nthe tree through growing through it.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n西邊可以看到那艘可憐的\n船，樹就那樣從中間長穿過去。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Apparently, some small animal wandered into
the anti-grav beam when you turned it on.  When the
timer ran out and the beam turned off the poor thing
came down hard.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
看來你打開反重力光束時，
有隻小動物誤闖了進去。
計時結束、光束關閉後，
這可憐的傢伙就重重摔了
下來。
